content:
name: Deploy Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "dist/**"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml"
      - "scripts/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "docs/deployment/github-pages.md"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages-arquivo-zero
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate baselines
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm

      - name: Install CI dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: SCHEMA_PASS (game.json 3.x)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/validate-case.mjs dist/game.json | tee /tmp/schema.out
          grep -E 'SCHEMA_PASS[[:space:]]+version=3\.x[[:space:]]+issues=0' /tmp/schema.out

      - name: FUNCTION_MAP_PASS (total=78)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/verify-function-map.mjs | tee /tmp/fmap.out
          grep -E 'FUNCTION_MAP_PASS[[:space:]]+total=78' /tmp/fmap.out

      - name: EVIDENCE_MIGRATION_PASS (tests=29)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node tests/content/evidence-migration.test.mjs | tee /tmp/emig.out
          grep -E 'EVIDENCE_MIGRATION_PASS[[:space:]]+tests=29' /tmp/emig.out

      - name: EVIDENCE_POLICY_PASS (tests=15)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node tests/domain/evidence-policy.test.mjs | tee /tmp/epol.out
          grep -E 'EVIDENCE_POLICY_PASS[[:space:]]+tests=15' /tmp/epol.out

      - name: EVIDENCE_SERVICE_PASS (tests=18)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node tests/domain/evidence-service.test.mjs | tee /tmp/esvc.out
          grep -E 'EVIDENCE_SERVICE_PASS[[:space:]]+tests=18' /tmp/esvc.out

      - name: HOTFIX_SUITE_PASS (tests=4)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node tests/hotfix/run-all.mjs | tee /tmp/hf.out
          grep -E 'HOTFIX_SUITE_PASS[[:space:]]+tests=4' /tmp/hf.out

      - name: Relative asset paths and dist guards
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if grep -EOut ' (src|href)="/[^"]+"' dist/index.html; then
            echo "Absolute root paths found in dist/index.html" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          test -f dist/.nojekyll
          test -f dist/game.json
          test -f dist/app.js
          test -d dist/modules
          test ! -e dist/.roadmap
          test ! -e dist/.env

      - name: ESAA verify when CLI available
        run: |
          if python3 -m esaa --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            python3 -m esaa --root . verify
          else
            echo "esaa CLI not installed on runner; skipped (operator verifies locally)."
          fi

  deploy:
    name: Deploy dist to GitHub Pages
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ensure .nojekyll and dist-only guards
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f dist/.nojekyll || : > dist/.nojekyll
          test -d dist
          test ! -e dist/.roadmap
          test ! -e dist/.env

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload dist only
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: dist

      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

  smoke:
    name: Smoke published URL
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: HTTP 200 for index, game.json, ESM modules
        env:
          PAGE_BASE: https://elzobrito.github.io/Arquivo-Zero
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          paths=(
            "/"
            "/index.html"
            "/game.json"
            "/modules/evidence-policy.js"
            "/modules/ui/evidence/evidence-board.js"
            "/app.js"
            "/styles.css"
          )
          for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
            ok=1
            for path in "${paths[@]}"; do
              url="${PAGE_BASE}${path}"
              code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/body -w "%{http_code}" -L "$url" || true)
              echo "attempt=${attempt} $url -> $code"
              if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then ok=0; fi
            done
            if [ "$ok" = "1" ]; then
              echo "SMOKE_PASS"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 20
          done
          echo "Smoke failed after retries" >&2
          exit 1
